definition_en: to cry out loudly and unrestrainedly; to shout; to shout at someone
core_image: 婴儿憋足了劲的嚎啕，整个屋子都听得见
scene: 儿科诊室里针头刚落下，孩子的哭声掀翻屋顶。The toddler began to bawl the moment the shot was given.
sceneCN: 这里 bawl 指「嚎啕大哭」（第 1 个义项：放声大哭）；句意：针一打下去，幼儿就嚎啕大哭起来。

senses.title: To cry loudly
senses.definition: to cry out noisily and without restraint
senses.example: The baby bawled all through the night.
senses.why: Middle English bawlen meant to bark or howl: the mouth opens wide.
senses.whyCN: 中古英语 bawlen 意为吠、嚎：嘴张到最大。

senses.title: To shout
senses.definition: to call out in a loud, rough voice
senses.example: Vendors bawled their prices across the square.
senses.exampleCN: 小贩们在广场上高声叫卖。
senses.why: The same wide-open mouth serves outrage or commerce.
senses.whyCN: 同一张大嘴，既可宣泄，也可做买卖。

senses.title: To scold loudly
senses.definition: to shout at someone in anger
senses.example: The sergeant bawled out the recruit.
senses.why: Anger borrows the volume of grief.

senses.title: Cattle bawling
senses.definition: of cattle, to cry loudly, as in hunger or distress
senses.definitionCN: 指牛因饥饿或不安而哞叫
senses.example: The calves bawled for their mothers.
senses.why: The bark-word suits animals best of all.

senses.title: Bawl out idiom
senses.example: I got bawled out for being late.
senses.why: The scolding sense fixed into a phrasal verb.
senses.whyCN: 训斥义固化为短语动词。

senses.title: To bawl one's eyes out
senses.titleCN: 习语 bawl one's eyes out
senses.example: She bawled her eyes out at the funeral.
senses.exampleCN: 她在葬礼上哭得死去活来。
senses.why: The idiom exaggerates crying into loss.
senses.whyCN: 习语把哭夸张成「哭掉眼睛」。

senses.title: Figurative public outcry
senses.exampleCN: 人群高喊要求公平价格。

senses.title: Bawling of newborns
senses.definition: the first loud cries at birth
senses.example: The delivery room waited for the first bawl.
senses.exampleCN: 产房里所有人都在等第一声啼哭。
senses.why: Life announces itself at full volume.
senses.whyCN: 生命以最大音量宣告到场。

intro.en: Bawl comes from Middle English bawlen, to bark or howl, probably from Old Norse baula, to low like a cow, with influence from bark; the wide-mouthed cry unites all senses.
intro.cn: bawl 出自中古英语 bawlen「吠、嚎」，或源于古诺斯语 baula「牛哞叫」，并受 bark 影响；「张大嘴喊哭」把诸义串在一起。

items.cn: 古诺斯语 baula 指牛的哞叫。

items.en: bawlen meant to bark, howl, or cry out.
items.cn: 中古英语 bawlen 意为吠、嚎、喊。

items.en: The scolding sense and bawl out grew.
items.cn: 训斥义与 bawl out 相继出现。

items.en: The word stays informal and vivid.
items.cn: 该词保持口语色彩与画面感。

note.en: Group one holds the howling family and look-alikes; group two holds the crying field.
note.cn: 第一组收「嚎叫」词族与形近词；第二组收「啼哭」义场。

entries.definition: a round object; from Old Norse bollr, unrelated to crying.
entries.definitionCN: 球；出古诺斯语 bollr，与哭喊无关。

entries.definition: to refuse or hesitate; from Old Norse balkr.
entries.definitionCN: 拒绝；畏缩不前；出 balkr，无关。

entries.definition: to cry with a long, high sound of grief.

normalIntro.en: bawl is a ball of sound thrown out of a wide-open mouth.
normalIntro.cn: bawl 是从大张的嘴里抛出的一团声音之球。

normal.en: Root: Old Norse baula, low like a cow.
normal.cn: 词根：古诺斯语 baula「牛哞」。

normal.en: Spelling: bawl, like ball with a w of sound.
normal.cn: 拼法：bawl，ball 换个会发声的 w。

abstract.en: Hear a sound that fills the whole house.
abstract.cn: 听那灌满整座房子的声音。

abstract.en: Bawl is grief at full volume.
abstract.cn: bawl 是开到最大音量的悲伤。

abstract.en: The first cry of a newborn is its first argument for attention.
abstract.cn: 新生儿的啼哭是它对世界的第一次索取。

examples.en: The toddler bawled until he got the toy.
examples.cn: 幼儿一直嚎哭，直到拿到玩具。

examples.en: She bawled at the umpire from the stands.
examples.cn: 她在看台上朝裁判大喊。

examples.en: We could hear the cattle bawling in the storm.
examples.cn: 暴风雨里能听见牛群哞叫。

root: 出自中古英语 bawlen「吠、嚎、喊」，或源于古诺斯语 baula「牛哞叫」；本指牲畜叫声，后专指人放声大哭与大声呵斥。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses open one mouth: the loud cry, the shout, the scolding, the cattle, the two idioms, the public protest, and the newborn's first bawl.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项出自同一张嘴：嚎哭、喊叫、训斥、牛哞、两个习语、公开抗议与新生儿初啼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mouth wide open, sound spilling without control.
core.cn: 核心意象：嘴张到最大，声音失控地涌出。

branches.en: The cry frames life: newborn and heartbreak.
branches.cn: 啼哭框住生命：初生与心碎。

branches.en: Shouts and protests share the volume.
The cow keeps the oldest sense.

intro.en: The bawl family stays close to the mouth: verb, agent, and the fixed phrases.
intro.cn: bawl 词族紧贴嘴巴：动词、施动者与固定短语。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin; the line runs through Old Norse cattle calls, so the Latin table stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同源词，词线出自古诺斯语牛鸣，拉丁同族表留空。
